8-week interview direction

₹30+ LPA target
Weeks 1–2 · Java depth & coding

Collections, concurrency, JVM, modern Java, Streams and timed coding rounds.

Weeks 3–4 · Spring, API, security & persistence

Spring internals, REST, production troubleshooting, JPA and transaction semantics.

Weeks 5–6 · SQL, messaging & distributed systems

SQL performance, Kafka, microservices, resilience, design patterns and deployment.

Week 7 · Testing, leadership & gap closure

JUnit/Mockito, senior-level ownership stories and targeted fundamentals diagnostics.

Week 8 · Interview simulations

Java, SQL, coding, HLD/LLD, full-stack and project/behavioural mock rounds.

Firebase setup checklist
  1. Create a Firebase project and register a Web app.
  2. Enable Authentication → Sign-in method → Google.
  3. Create a Cloud Firestore database.
  4. Add your GitHub Pages hostname under Authentication → Settings → Authorized domains.
  5. Paste the Web app config above and sign in with Google.
  6. Publish the Firestore security rules from the README before using cloud sync.
